node.title: Re: Golf code in perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As far as I can tell this question was [http://codegolf.stackexchange.com/questions/112630/help-me-reduce-my-perl-code|cross-posted to StackExchange]*, where the source of this problem was cited as [https://www.hackerearth.com/challenge/competitive/international-women-hackathon-2017/golf/modulo-strength-4/|HackerEarth]. Cross-posting is considered acceptable as long as you inform readers, so that efforts are not duplicated.

Update: * The link above has now gone dead. The one posted in a reply below is currently still good: [http://stackoverflow.com/questions/42733000/code-golf-in-perl]
